exposure: Women who did not undergo ECV
outcome: Reasons for breech presentation at term birth
Changes in ECV counseling, referral, and attempt rates
cohort: 394 babies in breech presentation at term birth in a large United Kingdom maternity unit
finding: Despite improvements in ECV counseling and referral rates, failure to diagnose breech presentation antenatally has become the primary barrier to successful ECV.
mod_finding: The study found that the main barrier to successful external cephalic version (ECV), a procedure to reduce breech presentation and cesarean delivery, is the failure to diagnose breech presentation antenatally.
